text: Menen Men Wahyinii e maaɗa an Nulaaɗo, wano Men Wahyinirnoo e Annabaaɓe ɓen ado maaɗa, wanaa e maa ɗum fuɗɗori. Men Wahyiri- no faade Nuuhu, Men Wahyini kadi faade e ɓen Annabaaɓe arnooɓe caggal Makko, Men Wahyini faade e Ibraahiima, e ɓiɗɓe makko ɓen ɗiɗo : Ismaa'iila e Ishaaqa, e faade e Yaaquuba ɓiɗɗo Ishaaqa, e Asbaati'en (ɓen woni jeyanooɓe e leƴƴi banii-israa'iila'en ɗin sappo e ɗiɗi ka ɓiɗɓe Yaaquuba jom-kisiee). Men Okki Daawuuda Deftere Jabuura nden.
